title: Smoke & Fire: A BBQ Analogy Board

sets.relationshipLabel: a category and a specific kind within it
sets.explanation: Cut and wood are broad categories, while brisket and mesquite name a specific member of each.

sets.relationshipLabel: a cooking apparatus and the component it necessarily has
sets.explanation: An offset smoker always has a firebox and a grill always has a grate — the part is built into the definition of the whole.

sets.relationshipLabel: a tool and the action it exists to perform
sets.explanation: A mop exists to baste and a spatula exists to flip — each tool is defined by the single motion it's built for.

sets.relationshipLabel: an action and the action that undoes it
sets.explanation: Extinguish undoes ignite and unwrap undoes wrap — each right-hand word cancels what the left-hand word set in motion.
